messages:
Maya: Dropping an alternate onboarding framework for feedback. Names: Express / Core / Vault. Express = 1-3w fast lane, minimal harness. Core = standard path with full evals + staged canary. Vault = regulated/private customers, full security & longer runway.

Jorge: How do we prioritize backlog items?

Maya: New score (0-100): priority = clamp( (impact*40 + revenue*30 - infra_cost*20 - risk*10), 0,100 ). impact 0-10, revenue 0-10, infra_cost 0-10, risk 0-10. Sort desc, tie-breaker = customer tenure.

Sophia: Concrete canary defaults pls.

Maya: Canary: cohort = min(1% tenant traffic, 3k req/day), windows = 36h gen / 72h embed, gates = latency p50 delta <=30ms, error rate delta <=3%, eval regression <=2pts, hallucination <=1.3x baseline. Auto-stop on gate breach.

Ben: Pin tiers?

Maya: Propose pin TTLs: 7d / 30d / 180d. Any pin >30d requires signed migration plan or reserved capacity. Vault customers can request longer holds via exception ticket with legal + security signoff.

Eva: Finance will need a sample: show impact for 5M tokens/month at +10% unit cost. Include that in RFC.

Sophia: Platform runs canary automation and metric collection; model owners provide eval sets and sign rollout steps.

deploy-bot: Canary started for model "rwd-lite-3" on tenant "DataCo" cohort=1.1k req/day duration=36h. Monitoring hooks enabled.

Maya: I'll turn this into a short RFC + scorecard and add two billing worked examples. Please react with quick thumbs.

Jorge: +1
Sophia: +1
Ben: +1
Eva: +1 (need billing examples)
